latHint: Think invisible, high-energy rays from exploding stars.
pivHint: A DELTA is where a river fans into the sea - but it is also the letter after alpha, beta, and ______.
winText: Right on the letter. DELTA was the pivot - a river mouth to the letter after GAMMA.
lossText: GAMMA - the third letter, after alpha and beta. DELTA was the pivot: a river DELTA, and the letter DELTA that follows GAMMA.
